title: Anthropic Files for IPO: What It Means for Enterprise AI Strategy
excerpt: Anthropic's confidential S-1 filing marks a turning point for the AI industry. For enterprises building on Claude, the implications go well beyond the stock price.
author: Greg Loeffelholz

title: Why Anthropic's Stainless Acquisition Matters (And What Competitors Do Next)
excerpt: This was not an acquisition to make Claude smarter. It was an acquisition to make Claude easier to connect, deploy, and use everywhere. The AI race is shifting from model intelligence to system integration.
author: Greg Loeffelholz

title: Multi-Model Strategy Is Table Stakes for AI in 2026
excerpt: The 'pick one model' era is over. Smart deployments pair models to task complexity and build price-based waterfalls for cost efficiency -- and that's no longer optimization, it's the baseline.
author: Greg Loeffelholz
